name: Hector Gonzalez
title: Full-Stack Engineer · Front End · Applied AI
tagline: Product-minded full-stack engineer, strongest on the front end, who ships AI features.
bio: Six years across a large bank's web properties and a production edtech platform I co-architected and now run for ~24,000 users. I own the whole product: React and Next.js front ends, data, auth, CI/CD, monitoring, and the AI pipeline that cut lesson production from about a week to 10–30 minutes.
